usedFor: lemcal holds booked meetings, and Moco turns each into agency work through “Create Deal” or “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Meeting” in lemcal, then “Create Deal” in Moco
bestTemplate.why: A booked meeting is a new lead, and this records it as one in Moco.

watchOut: “Create Deal” creates a lead each time, so a repeat booker adds a second one.
